summary: vmware.vmware_rest deprecates modules that moved to vmware.vmware, including vcenter_vm_guest_customization and the vcenter_vm_hardware_* modules for SATA, SCSI, CD-ROM, CPU, disk, ethernet and memory.
questions: Which vmware_rest modules moved to vmware.vmware?

answer_card.title: vmware_rest modules moved to vmware.vmware
answer_card.answer_md: vmware.vmware_rest deprecates modules that moved to the **vmware.vmware** collection, including `vcenter_vm_guest_customization`, `vcenter_vm_hardware_adapter_sata`, `vcenter_vm_hardware_adapter_scsi`, `vcenter_vm_hardware_cdrom`, `vcenter_vm_hardware_cpu`, `vcenter_vm_hardware_disk`, `vcenter_vm_hardware_ethernet` and `vcenter_vm_hardware_memory` (the list continues in the full guide).
